features.featureTitle: Replace the current saturated yellow theme with a clean white theme across the entire application. Update the CSS color tokens in frontend/src/index.css and frontend/index.css so that backgrounds use white/near-white tones (OKLCH with high lightness, zero or near-zero chroma), foreground/text remains dark (near-black), and accent/interactive colors shift to neutral grays or a subtle off-white palette. Ensure no yellow background colors remain on cards, headers, hero sections, buttons, or any UI element.
